claims.statement: A provider is detected only when its *_API_KEY is non-empty after strip; Ollama is included when OLLAMA_API_KEY is set even if LiteLLM inference omitted it.
resolve_model requires at least one catalog entry and accepts an exact id or a unique suffix match, otherwise UnknownModelError.
POST /v1/embeddings resolves the catalog model, applies budget and identity RPM, then calls router.aembedding rather than ChatService.
